**Vaughan Ling** is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel in 2011. He was the lead designer for the 2012 [DC Character Cars](/wiki/DC_Character_Cars) line, and assisted with the 3D production of [Superman](/wiki/Superman). Vaughan has since worked at various animation studios and manages his website *heavypoly*.
